description: User-perceived characters (cursor steps) of a text: what one Backspace or one Left arrow crosses in GTK, Qt, Chromium, Firefox and Cocoa; the Windows hosts are a field check (TODO-tests-windows.md). The hotstring Undo erases an expansion by these steps. Replayed by the Linux injector (modules/hotstrings/injector.lua caret_steps) and the macOS composed-text walk (infra/composed_text.lua count), both through _shared/tests/lua/hotstrings/caret_steps_contract.lua, and by the AutoHotkey port (windows/core/text/engine/utils.ahk _TextCaretSteps, tests/unit/core/text/test_utils.ahk). Not a complete UAX #29 engine: the rules cover what an expansion types.
